LESSON: VIRTUES AND PRINCIPLES OF DHARMA IN BUDDHISM

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Principles of Dharma
Topic 7.1: Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important to observe virtues for righteousness?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the primary virtues from Buddhist stories for righteousness

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the primary virtues from Buddhist stories for righteousness

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe the primary virtues from Buddhist stories for righteousness.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “describe the primary virtues from Buddhist stories for righteousness” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe the primary virtues from Buddhist stories for righteousness” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe the primary virtues from Buddhist stories for righteousness" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the primary virtues from Buddhist stories for righteousness

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the primary virtues from Buddhist stories for righteousness

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to observe virtues for righteousness?
2. How can one implement Principles of Dharma in daily life?
3. How can Principles of Dharma be applied in classroom situations?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the primary virtues from Buddhist stories for righteousness

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
